name: Roblox Luau Quest & Objective Tracker
description: Typed Roblox Luau ModuleScript service for tracking per-player quest states, incrementing objective counters, and emitting completion rewards cleanly on the server.

preview.caption: Roblox Luau server module — store QuestConfig in ReplicatedStorage and QuestService in ServerScriptService.
preview.projectRef: Place QuestConfig.luau in ReplicatedStorage/Quests/ and QuestService.luau in ServerScriptService/Quests/.

install: Place QuestConfig.luau as a ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage and QuestService.luau in ServerScriptService.
usage: Require QuestService on the server, call QuestService.AcceptQuest(player.UserId, "slime_hunt"), and report progress via QuestService.RecordProgress(player.UserId, "defeat_slime", 1).

verification.label: Source Reviewed (Roblox Luau)
verification.details: Strict Luau type annotations (--!strict) with server-authoritative state isolation; execute inside Roblox Studio.
